# Release history

The version badge in the nav links here. It bumps on every push to `dev`, and CI refuses a release whose `version.txt` and commit subject disagree.

The games have their own release history, in the vault and independent of this site's: `version.html` inside vault `4evnlwrj`, 28 releases at v0.16.1. This table tracks the site that describes them.
